Card Q&A.q: I use this card's effect to delete 1 of my purple Digimon. Can I then return that Digimon card to my hand with this card's effect?

Card Q&A.a: The [On Deletion] effect is triggered, but it cannot activate because the Digimon card leaves the trash before that.
Card Q&A.q: I use this card’s effect to delete 1 of my purple Digimon with an [On Deletion] effect and return it to my hand. What happens to the [On Deletion] effect?

Effect: [Main] Delete 1 of your Digimon. Then, return up to 2 purple Digimon cards from your trash to your hand.
Security Effect: [Security] Add this card to its owner's hand.
